plan.title: Entropy: Why Messes Happen
plan.description: Entropy explained in thirty seconds: why order falls apart and disorder wins. A quick look at the idea behind melting ice, mixed coffee and the arrow of time.

beats.narration: Why does your room get messy, but never tidy itself? The answer is entropy, and it rules the universe.
Entropy measures how many ways things can be arranged. A tidy room has few. A messy one has countless, so mess wins.
That is why ice melts, coffee cools and time only moves forward. Nature drifts toward disorder, simply because it is likelier.

props.text: Nature drifts toward the likeliest arrangement: disorder.
